db_walbackstop.go:*baseDB.tryTruncateChe.reason: patch/73 backstop, own goroutine and connection. Step 1: PASSIVE checkpoint without updateLock, the same unlocked-maintenance class as the periodic PASSIVE in tidy (copies frames, never waits). Step 2 only if step 1 reached the WAL end: takes baseDB updateLock, sets busy_timeout 200 ms on its own connection, runs wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) (at most the frames written since step 1), restores busy_timeout, releases. A reader in the way yields SQLITE_BUSY after 200 ms, reported as busy and retried later; no in-process writer can be blocked longer than that.
